match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. medium wide. eye level. SCARLETT centered in the crosswalk with taxis and glass office towers layered behind her. SCARLETT steps forward, filming herself with one hand and holding her coffee level with the other. Then: SCARLETT walks against the crosswalk flow while filming herself and keeping her coffee steady. Camera: handheld follow, brisk, lively. Keep city movement alive around her without losing her face. Characters: Scarlett: Woman, 22, A striking, fresh-faced 22-year-old beauty creator: dewy, even skin, high cheekbones, wide dark eyes, a sleek dark bob, and bare, full lips ready for colour, wearing Black fitted turtleneck, slim black trousers, small gold hoop earrings. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
